appfunction.name: power
appfunction.description: Turn the paired LG NetCast television on or off. Turning on uses Wake-on-LAN and needs the TV's MAC address saved in the app.

appfunction.name: mute
appfunction.description: Mute or unmute the paired LG NetCast television.

appfunction.name: setVolume
appfunction.description: Move the television volume toward a level from 0 to 100 by repeating the volume keys.

appfunction.name: channelUp
appfunction.description: Change to the next channel on the paired television.

appfunction.name: channelDown
appfunction.description: Change to the previous channel on the paired television.

appfunction.name: tune
appfunction.description: Tune the television to a channel number such as 11-1 or a channel name.

appfunction.name: launchApp
appfunction.description: Launch an application installed on the television by name.

appfunction.name: runMacro
appfunction.description: Run a named macro such as Movie on the paired television.
